adjudications: 8.10.1.1 p1: EQUIVALENCE causes storage association; p2: no type conversion or mathematical equivalence is implied. Values are read through the alias only where 19.5.3 and 19.6.5/19.6.6 define them - same type and kind, numeric sequence storage, character with character.
The numeric-sequence fixture reads same-kind INTEGER component storage; the non-default COMPLEX fixture pairs the same type and kind. Both are portable, so LFortran's failures are genuine defects.
C8113/C8114/C8115/C8117/C8120 facets are admission-side; negatives stay pending.
